title: Public Mint Authorization — Final (Guardian Path Defined)

authorization_details.supply_rule: One NFT per registerModel call; no max supply cap, but controlled mint limited to 1 for Phase 13
authorization_details.fee_rule: No fixed fee; OINIO stakeAmount > 0 required per mint, transferred to registry
authorization_details.metadata_rule: metadataURI must be non-empty; creator defined; verified on-chain via ModelRegistered event
authorization_details.risk_warning: NEVER enter seed phrase. NEVER send funds manually. Only use official site. Verify contract address 0x67aD7169184581f23D1E10B39d4eb4e98293E87a on 0G Aristotle Mainnet (chain 16661).

guardian_authorization_path: 1. Guardian defines recipient_address, metadata_uri, stake_amount_oinio in Phase 13 human decisions receipt
2. Guardian seals Phase 13 final pre-execution authorization receipt
3. Operator executes exactly one registerModel call (approve + registerModel)
4. Post-execution verification receipt sealed with tx hash, block number, model ID
5. Only after verification, Phase 14 public mint opening may be considered
required_before_guardian_grants_authoriz: Guardian confirms contract source verified: registerModel calls transferFrom and mints ERC721
Operator explicitly confirms no automatic execution without guardian approval

registerModel_effects: Emits ModelRegistered(modelId, creator, name, metadataURI, stakeAmount)
